headline: Executive order signed in January 2021 requiring mask-wearing to protect the federal workforce.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order requires people to wear masks in order to protect federal workers. It was signed on President Biden's first day in office, during the COVID-19 pandemic. No official summary was provided, so the exact rules, places covered, and enforcement details are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at protecting federal workers, likely through mask requirements at work.

who_it_affects.group: People in or around federal workplaces
who_it_affects.how: Others at federal sites may also have been required to wear masks, though the title alone does not say exactly who.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2021; the title alone does not state a separate start date.
